title: Antibiotic resistance genes and intI1 gene associated in field-collected microplastic samples
description: The goal is to detect the abundance of ARGs and intI1 genes associated with microplastsics in a freshwater system. Samples were collected from the effluent of a domestic wastewater treatment plant in South Korea.
